claim: The statue was installed on September 16 during Constitution Week, part of the nation’s 250th anniversary celebrations.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: [AI label: Claude, 2026-10-05 - not yet checked by the human annotator] Installed on 16 Sept (The Indiana Citizen, 29 Sep 2026); 'unveiled as part of Constitution Week and tied to the nation's 250th-birthday celebrations' (Hoodline, 29 Sep). Constitution Week is formally 17-23 Sept, so the 16th is its eve; counted as holding because the unveiling was presented as part of it.
